主要内容: On February 12, 2015, Geospace Technologies Corporation (GEOSPACE) held its Annual Meeting of Stockholders in Houston, Texas. Shareholders voted on four proposals: (1) electing Tina M. Langtry, Michael J. Sheen, and Charles H. Still as directors for three-year terms; (2) ratifying the appointment of BDO USA, LLP as auditors; (3) approving an advisory vote on executive compensation; and (4) approving the reincorporation from Delaware to Texas. All proposals were approved. CEO Rick Wheeler made remarks to shareholders, which are included as Exhibit 99.1. The report was filed with the SEC on February 13, 2015, and signed by Thomas T. McEntire, Vice President, Chief Financial Officer, and Secretary of the company.
